answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 43881 Country: India Title: salah Question: I work on ship and ship moves from one country to another, I want to know that am I musafir I will pray qasr or normal namaz. Please guide me. Answer ID: 43881 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 317/249/B=1434) Yes, you shall be musafir (traveller), in case you offer salah alone you should offer four rakah salah as 2 ra’kah i.e. you shall do qasr. Yes, if you intend to stay at a place for fourteen days then you shall turn muqim and offer full salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
